resources.string: Foqos watches which app comes to the foreground so it can show the focus shield over apps you chose to block during a session. Foqos reads only the package name of the foreground app. Nothing is recorded, sent anywhere, or stored beyond the running session.
Lets Foqos suspend blocked apps at the system level. Only available when Foqos is provisioned as device owner via ADB.
Shows the running focus session, its timer and break controls.
